# unifi_setting_super_mgmt (Resource)

The `unifi_setting_super_mgmt` resource manages controller-wide (super) management settings for a UniFi controller, including auto-upgrade, automatic backups, contact information, data retention, and related administrative options.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unifi_setting_super_mgmt" "example" {
  # Automatically upgrade device firmware.
  auto_upgrade = true

  # Device status LEDs.
  led_enabled = true

  # Contact information for the controller / owner.
  contact_info_full_name    = "Ada Lovelace"
  contact_info_company_name = "Analytical Engines"
  contact_info_country      = "US"
  contact_info_city         = "San Francisco"
  contact_info_state        = "CA"
  contact_info_zip          = "94105"

  # Statistics data retention.
  data_retention_setting_preference             = "manual"
  data_retention_time_in_hours_for_hourly_scale = 168
  data_retention_time_in_hours_for_daily_scale  = 720

  # This resource exposes many more controller-wide options (automatic backups,
  # analytics, live updates/chat, SSH credentials, minimum usable disk space,
  # override inform host, etc.). See the resource documentation for the full list.

  # Specify the site (optional, defaults to the site configured in the provider, otherwise "default")
  # site = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `analytics_disapproved_for` (String) Identifier of the analytics collection the user has disapproved.
- `auto_upgrade` (Boolean) Whether devices are automatically upgraded to new firmware.
- `autobackup_cron_expr` (String) Cron expression defining the automatic backup schedule.
- `autobackup_days` (Number) Number of days of data to include in automatic backups.
- `autobackup_enabled` (Boolean) Whether automatic backups are enabled.
- `autobackup_gcs_bucket` (String) Google Cloud Storage bucket name used for automatic backups.
- `autobackup_gcs_certificate_path` (String) Path to the Google Cloud Storage service account certificate used for backups.
- `autobackup_local_path` (String) Local filesystem path where automatic backups are stored.
- `autobackup_max_files` (Number) Maximum number of automatic backup files to retain.
- `autobackup_post_actions` (List of String) Actions performed after an automatic backup completes. Valid values: `copy_local`, `copy_gcs`, `copy_cloud`.
- `autobackup_timezone` (String) Timezone used when scheduling automatic backups.
- `backup_to_cloud_enabled` (Boolean) Whether backups are copied to the UniFi cloud.
- `contact_info_city` (String) Contact information: city.
- `contact_info_company_name` (String) Contact information: company name.
- `contact_info_country` (String) Contact information: country.
- `contact_info_full_name` (String) Contact information: full name.
- `contact_info_phone_number` (String) Contact information: phone number.
- `contact_info_shipping_address_1` (String) Contact information: first line of the shipping address.
- `contact_info_shipping_address_2` (String) Contact information: second line of the shipping address.
- `contact_info_state` (String) Contact information: state or province.
- `contact_info_zip` (String) Contact information: postal / ZIP code.
- `data_retention_setting_preference` (String) Data retention preference. Valid values: `auto`, `manual`.
- `data_retention_time_in_hours_for_5minutes_scale` (Number) Retention time (hours) for statistics at the 5-minute scale.
- `data_retention_time_in_hours_for_daily_scale` (Number) Retention time (hours) for statistics at the daily scale.
- `data_retention_time_in_hours_for_hourly_scale` (Number) Retention time (hours) for statistics at the hourly scale.
- `data_retention_time_in_hours_for_monthly_scale` (Number) Retention time (hours) for statistics at the monthly scale.
- `data_retention_time_in_hours_for_others` (Number) Retention time (hours) for other statistics categories.
- `default_site_device_auth_password_alert` (String) Default site device authentication password alert setting.
- `discoverable` (Boolean) Whether the controller is discoverable on the network.
- `enable_analytics` (Boolean) Whether usage analytics collection is enabled.
- `google_maps_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Google Maps API key used for map rendering.
- `image_maps_use_google_engine` (Boolean) Whether the Google Maps engine is used for image maps.
- `led_enabled` (Boolean) Whether device status LEDs are enabled.
- `live_chat` (String) Live chat availability. Valid values: `disabled`, `super-only`, `everyone`.
- `live_updates` (String) Live updates mode. Valid values: `disabled`, `live`, `auto`.
- `minimum_usable_hd_space` (Number) Minimum usable hard-disk space (in MB) before alerts are raised.
- `minimum_usable_sd_space` (Number) Minimum usable SD-card space (in MB) before alerts are raised.
- `multiple_sites_enabled` (Boolean) Whether multiple sites are enabled on the controller.
- `override_inform_host` (Boolean) Whether the inform host is overridden for device communication.
- `override_inform_host_location` (String) Override inform host location (hostname or IP) used by devices to reach the controller.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `store_enabled` (String) UniFi store availability. Valid values: `disabled`, `super-only`, `everyone`.
- `time_series_per_client_stats_enabled` (Boolean) Whether per-client time-series statistics are collected.
- `x_ssh_password` (String, Sensitive) SSH password used for device management.
- `x_ssh_username` (String, Sensitive) SSH username used for device management.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
